source_excerpt:
The MPESB will close the online applications process for the posts of sub engineer on October 27, 2026. Interested candidates can submit their online application through the official website at esb.mp.gov.in. Check this article for the detailed eligibility criteria, application process, fees etc.
MP Sub Engineer Vacancy 2026: The Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB) is all set to close the online application process for the posts of Sub Engineer today October 27, 2026. The online application process was started from August 29, 2026. These posts fall under the Sub Group 3. Eligible and interested candidates who have not yet submitted their application can do it through the official website of MPESB at esb.mp.gov.in. Initially the last date to apply was September 12, 2026. Further the online applications were once again reopened from October 13, 2026 to October 27, 2026 in order to provide another chance for those candidates who could not submit their forms. Through this recruitment drive a total of 1700 vacancies would be filled across various posts such as Sub Engineer, Draftsman, Lab Technician and others.
In this article you will find all the important details related to the eligibility criteria, application process, fees and other details before applying online through the official website.
MP Sub Engineer Vacancy 2026 Apply Online Link
Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can submit their application online. Applicants are advised to read the official notification once before filling the online forms. The online form is available on the MPESB website at esb.mp.gov.in .
